name: Credit cover response type code
description: Code specifying the type of response to a request for credit cover.

values.name: Preliminary assessment
values.description: Preliminary assessment A preliminary assessment without formal approval or commitment.

values.name: Approved
values.description: Approved The limit request has been approved.

values.name: Not approved
values.description: Not approved The limit request has not been approved.

values.name: Conditional approval
values.description: Conditional approval Approval subject to conditions as specified.

values.name: Partly approved
values.description: Partly approved Partly approved as specified.

values.name: Still investigating
values.description: Still investigating The limit request is still under investigation.

values.name: Open new account only
values.description: Open new account only Buyer account has been opened without an approved limit.

values.name: Cancellation
values.description: Cancellation The existing limit has been cancelled.

values.name: Change of name and/or address
values.description: Change of name and/or address The name and/or address of the buyer has changed.

values.name: Close buyer's account
values.description: Close buyer's account The buyer's account is to be closed.
